state_council_notice.title: 国务院办公厅关于2026年部分节假日安排的通知
state_council_notice.use: Identifies weekend days the government marks as 上班. Those days are not exchange sessions. The SSE notice lists them as 周末休市.

szse_notice.note: One response began with the title 关于2026年中秋节、国庆节休 and later requests returned HTTP 502. The body was not saved. This calendar does not quote that page and does not treat it as a verified SZSE full-year transcript.

rule: Inside 2026, a date in a closure below is a holiday. Any other Saturday or Sunday is not a session, including a State Council makeup workday. Any other 2026 weekday is an ordinary session because the SSE notice says trading resumes after each listed holiday and names no other 2026 weekday closure. A date outside 2026 is unknown and is not admitted.
